items.title: Your Nvidia Weight Sets How Much A Fall Hurts
items.summary: Nvidia closed at $150.96 on Wednesday, Nov 18. That is 36.9% below its record close of $239.24 on Oct 6. Wednesday's 2.9% drop came the day after Nvidia's third-quarter report. Revenue rose 103% from a year earlier, to $115.8 billion.

items.title: Qualcomm (QCOM) Stock May Be Below Fair Value After AI Revenue Targets
items.summary: QUALCOMM has seen a mixed few years on the market, with the share price moving but the real story sitting in the cash that the business can generate. The question for you now is whether the current US$159.81 price tag lines up with what its future cash flows suggest, especially after the latest swings in the wider chip sector. Over the past 3 years, QUALCOMM has delivered a total return of about 33.6%, which puts real weight on whether that share price now reflects its underlying cash...

items.title: Marvell And Intel Halved: How Long Until They Recover?
items.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. Intel closed at $55.17, 60.9% below its June 22 high. Most talk about the chip selloff is a buy-the-dip call or a warning that the AI trade is over. This article asks a narrower question. When a chip stock halves, how often does it get back to its high, and how long does it take.
